recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR core. If the work group still wants copy buttons on ValueSet expansion rows in addition to CodeSystem concept rows, pursue that in the IG Publisher/rendering tooling rather than as a speculative FHIR core source patch.
issue_request: FHIR-31356 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I enhancement request to add quick links for copying Coding snippets from value-set and code-system terminology enumerations. The resolution described the feature as a nice-to-have IG-authoring aid and left feasibility and usability to the tooling implementer.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 3c14d8332bfdbe37e581f52573d53f44e9b435f0, which added icon_clipboard_j.png and icon_clipboard_x.png. Nearby commit ab3a27bc56c3d212b592f187e9438b3e2a41339d added ClipboardJS assets, copy-button styling, and terminology template URL copy support.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 202105 minutes confirm approval pending feasibility. Current build.fhir.org CodeSystem pages include per-code XML and JSON clipboard buttons using the FHIR-31356 icon assets. Representative ValueSet expansion pages checked did not show per-row Coding copy buttons, but the generated expansion row renderer is not present as editable source in this FHIR checkout.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation records that the core source already carries the applied assets and helper support, and that implementing or changing generated ValueSet expansion row buttons would require external rendering tooling or a fresh usability decision.
